summary: Conviction under IPC s.302 and s.201; life imprisonment and 5-year RI upheld; recovery at instance under Evidence Act s.27 pivotal; discrepancies in seizure challenged; TIP and last-seen theory disputed; FSL confirms blood on seized stone; gold chains recovered from rooftop; motive linked to financial dispute; inconsistencies in witness accounts noted; prosecution case sustained on basis of disclosure and recovery.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence upheld.
